author: Yffe
content: Resolved in commit 9294377. Root cause closed at the ENUM DECLARATION per .design/basis/01-adts.md REQ-2: the declaration pre-pass Validator::new now rejects any enum variant whose first char is not is_ascii_uppercase() with SpecError::InvalidVariantCasing { name, span }, seeded into the error list BEFORE the body/contract walk. This makes the parser case-based single-segment pattern disambiguation (uppercase to Pattern::Enum, lowercase to Pattern::Binding) SOUND: no lowercase variant can exist, so a lowercase pattern ident is unambiguously a binding and can never masquerade as a catch-all masking a non-exhaustive match. check_match_exhaustiveness is unchanged. The 2 pinned bypass tests updated to expect InvalidVariantCasing{foo}/{tri} (R-CHAR-3; CORE pin holds, no silent accept); added positive companion exhaustiveness_intact_uppercase_nonexhaustive proving an UPPERCASE non-exhaustive match still yields NonExhaustiveMatch{missing:[Rect]}. Gauntlet: build --workspace green; test -p thermite-spec 0 failed; test --workspace 0 failed; clippy -D warnings PASS; fmt --check PASS.
